race.comment: Looks a lovely race for BRIDAL WALTZ (10) who gets in superbly under the set weights and penalty conditions. On official handicap she's clearly the highest-rated horse in the race yet gets in on the minimum given she hasn't won a stakes race in just over a year. Her return behind Oliveanotherday was rock solid and she gets every hope here. POINT BARROW (3) found the 1000m too sharp fresh in the G1 Moir Stakes in a race dominated on speed. She's unbeaten this route and will be very hard to run down. CUSTOM (4) was a strong winner of the G3 Courtza Stakes here last time. She had a lovely run but won well. PHOTOGRAPH (12) split them and will be running on.
